fronts.title: Recover a verifiable current candidate
fronts.objective: Restore a candidate-bound green Canonical CI and align HEAD, release_version, manifests, package metadata and release evidence without publishing a release unless all authorities agree.
acceptance: Canonical CI green for the exact candidate SHA

fronts.title: Close authority and evidence risks
fronts.objective: Eliminate paths that can validate or restore authority from evidence, package hashes, reviewers, sessions or workspaces not bound to the exact current candidate.
acceptance: legacy restore cannot silently regain authority

fronts.title: Consolidate the architectural kernel boundary
fronts.objective: Make the BAGO kernel boundary explicit as session + context + policy + providers + capabilities + security + evidence and prevent domain features from becoming kernel authority.
acceptance: kernel boundary documented and enforced by imports/contracts where practical

fronts.title: Unify the Python backend packaging model
fronts.objective: Reduce the structural duplication between backend/bago_core and backend/.bago/core, remove avoidable sys.path manipulation and establish normal versioned Python package boundaries incrementally without a flag-day rewrite.
acceptance: legacy imports isolated behind compatibility boundary
tests no longer rely on accidental repository layout for migrated modules

fronts.title: Formalize authority, state and workspace
fronts.objective: Ensure one source of truth for session, project, framework root, workspace root, persistent context and recovery; clients remain non-authoritative projections.

fronts.title: Contractualize context governance
fronts.objective: Turn classifier -> planner -> source resolution -> ranking -> contradiction detection -> verification -> token budget -> receipt into an explicit versioned subsystem contract.
acceptance: source authority and ranking reasons are inspectable
token budgeting is deterministic for fixtures

fronts.title: Rebuild model and provider routing around capabilities
fronts.objective: Separate model identity, observed capabilities, availability and routing policy; reduce hardcoded equivalence as a source of truth.
acceptance: hardcoded catalog is fallback or versioned evidence rather than sole authority

fronts.title: Create a stable versioned BAGO API and SDK boundary
fronts.objective: Expose sessions, chat, providers, switching, context, capabilities, permissions and evidence through stable versioned contracts without requiring clients to import internal modules.

fronts.title: Unify capabilities and permissions
fronts.objective: Require tools/plugins to declare filesystem, network, write, approval, dry-run and effect permissions and route all clients through the same enforcement layer.

fronts.title: Extract ecosystem projects from the kernel
fronts.objective: Define integration boundaries so domain repositories become capabilities/clients/knowledge providers instead of alternate BAGO authorities.
acceptance: no domain repository is required for kernel correctness

fronts.title: Resolve documentation and version canon drift
fronts.objective: Reduce authoritative documents, mark historical material explicitly and generate version/module/endpoint/provider state from machine authorities where possible.
acceptance: historical docs cannot masquerade as current canon
README/docs are consistent with source state

fronts.title: Security hardening
fronts.objective: Harden local API authentication, least privilege, secrets handling, tool isolation, supply-chain gates and execution receipts without breaking local-first operation.
acceptance: sensitive API operations require authenticated/session-bound access
critical dependency findings block protected integration paths

fronts.title: Manager and frontend completion on stable contracts
fronts.objective: Complete the manager/workspace UI only after backend contracts are stable: real model/provider selector, workspace editor, inspector, Agents, Interpreter, GitHub, simulation and evidence views.

fronts.title: Portability and deployment
fronts.objective: Make the headless kernel and packaging progressively portable to Linux/macOS while keeping Electron packaging separate from the core deployment contract.
acceptance: headless smoke path works cross-platform in CI where supported

fronts.title: Benchmark BAGO governance and routing
fronts.objective: Create reproducible benchmarks measuring whether context governance, switching and routing improve quality, cost, latency, continuity and error rate against explicit baselines.
acceptance: baseline and BAGO conditions are reproducible
claims are generated from measured evidence rather than narrative
